title: EXP-021-R3 — Clean Replay: Static Caption Recovery Across Ordinary Close/Reopen
objective: On a new User-scoped classic BuildFromScratch Form `FX_StaticCaptionLab03`, create exactly one Static component `FX_StaticCaptionStatic03`, record an exact pre-Caption comparison baseline, change only that component's Caption to `Static Caption Close Only Replay 3`, perform exactly one ordinary Designer Save to clean state, close the target exactly once through its ordinary Form-tab close control, reopen it exactly once through Designer Form-menu recent forms in the same Designer/client context, and verify that the same User-scoped Form recovers the Static with the exact Caption and unchanged comparison properties. Post-reopen rendered Static text must visibly corroborate the recovered Caption. Treat the result only as UI-level recovery across the tested weak close-only boundary; do not infer Forms-database durability, cache eviction, serialization provenance, or internal object identity.

in_scope: Read EXP-021, EXP-021-R2, EXP-003-R2, EXP-019-R2, recipes/forms/create-basic-form.md, recipes/components/add-component-from-toolbox.md, and recipes/components/configure-basic-component.md before mutation
One new User-scoped classic BuildFromScratch Form `FX_StaticCaptionLab03`

A pre-Caption baseline containing exact component Name, Caption, Type, From Device Master, Layout Size, Justification, and any other comparison properties exposed by the verified component workflow without changing them
One deliberate tested-property mutation: Static Caption to exactly `Static Caption Close Only Replay 3`
Exactly one ordinary Designer Save after the Caption mutation
Exactly one ordinary target Form-tab close
Exactly one Designer Form-menu recent-forms reopen in the same Designer/client context
Read-only post-reopen verification using Form Name + ScopeType + ScopeName and component Name + recorded comparison properties
Rendered-visible Static text captured separately from exact property-grid/accessibility-derived values
A final read-only action-count, live target-inventory, and repository-confinement audit

If the inherited Mongoose session is unusable before any target mutation, at most one supported pre-mutation session-establishment sequence may be used and disclosed, after which live-session, User-scope, and target-absence guards must be re-proven before mutation
out_of_scope: Any retry, continuation, or workaround for EXP-022 or its No Colon property
FormSync, generated metadata, scripts, event handlers, validators, bindings, IDO metadata, collections, or data sources
Explicit Form/global-object unload or any stronger persistence boundary
Forms-database durability, serialization provenance, cache eviction, or internal object-instance identity
Complete component-inventory claims unless independently proven by a supported visible inventory surface

prohibited_actions: Creating, modifying or deleting any non-FX_ artifact
Starting any other experiment or replay
Modifying production data or disabling security
Create, modify, rename, Save, Regenerate, or delete any non-FX_ Mongoose artifact
Invoke Unload All Global Form Objects or any other explicit unload
Change User Preferences, including Unload IDO Metadata With Forms
Create or modify Form variables, FormSync definitions, scripts, event handlers, validators, bindings, IDO metadata, collections, or data sources
Change or inspect the Static No Colon property as part of this experiment
Replace the existing Designer/client or introduce a stronger lifecycle boundary
After the pre-Caption baseline is captured, deliberately change the target Static's Name or any component property other than Caption
Perform authentication or session-establishment after the first target mutation
Manipulate hidden or off-screen controls to substitute for required rendered-visible evidence
Infer complete component cardinality from one creation action plus visible presence
Blindly repeat an interrupted browser or shell action; recovery is limited to one fresh snapshot and one corrected inspection, then a blocker
Expose credential values or weaken security

acceptance_checks.description: Before target mutation, visibly prove a usable live Mongoose workflow and Designer Editing Scope=User, then use the supported Select Form Name filter in case-insensitive mode with a visible known-existing positive control to prove `FX_StaticCaptionLab03` has zero matching rows. If one supported pre-mutation session-establishment sequence is needed, disclose it and repeat all guards afterward.

Create exactly one User-scoped classic BuildFromScratch Form `FX_StaticCaptionLab03` through the replay-verified fresh-dialog/basic-form path with Save Template visibly unchecked, and capture the loaded clean Form with Name + ScopeType + ScopeName identity.

Perform one Static creation operation, name it `FX_StaticCaptionStatic03`, and before the tested Caption mutation capture an exact property-grid/accessibility baseline for Name, Caption, Type, From Device Master, Layout Size, Justification, and every other comparison property exposed by the verified component workflow. Record any rendered canvas text separately and do not require it for this pre-mutation checkpoint.

After AC-3, change only the Static Caption to exactly `Static Caption Close Only Replay 3`. Capture the exact Caption plus unchanged comparison properties and the expected dirty Designer state. Pre-reopen canvas rendering is optional corroboration only; lack of rendered update at this stage does not fail the check.

Perform exactly one ordinary Designer Save after the Caption edit and prove the Designer returns clean while `FX_StaticCaptionStatic03` remains present with Caption exactly `Static Caption Close Only Replay 3` and all recorded non-Caption comparison properties unchanged.

Close `FX_StaticCaptionLab03` exactly once through its ordinary Form-tab close control and visibly prove the target tab is closed with no unsaved-change or unexpected prompt. Record that no explicit unload, Regenerate, preference change, client replacement, or post-mutation session-establishment action occurred.
Reopen the target exactly once through Designer Form-menu recent forms in the same Designer/client context and visibly verify the matching User-scoped Form identity by Name + ScopeType + ScopeName.

After reopen, verify `FX_StaticCaptionStatic03` is present with Caption exactly `Static Caption Close Only Replay 3` and every recorded non-Caption comparison property equal to the AC-3 baseline. Capture rendered Static text visibly showing `Static Caption Close Only Replay 3` as the decisive rendered-display corroboration, while making no internal-instance or complete-component-cardinality claim.

Final read-only audit must reconcile exactly one ordinary Save, one target Form-tab close, one recent-forms reopen, no deliberate target-property mutation after AC-3 except Caption, zero explicit unloads, zero Regenerates, zero preference changes, zero client replacements, and zero post-mutation authentication/session-establishment actions. A live case-insensitive Select Form check must show exactly one `FX_StaticCaptionLab03`; a session-expired or recovery-obstructed inventory read is invalid evidence and blocks replay verification rather than authorizing another recovery attempt. Repository changes must be confined to the EXP-021-R3 record and `evidence/EXP-021-R3/`.

notes: Proposed by the coordinator after run R-20261006-125233-BECN. Rationale: EXP-021 is an accepted single observation that a Static component Caption recovered across one ordinary Designer Save, Form-tab close, and recent-forms reopen, but it is not replay-verified. EXP-021-R2 never produced a qualifying replay because its preflight did not complete. EXP-022 is blocked on the separate No Colon property and should not be worked around. The smallest useful next step is therefore a fresh independent replay of the already-observed EXP-021 Static Caption procedure on a new FX_ Form, keeping rendered-caption evidence distinct from exact property-grid/accessibility evidence and requiring rendered text only at the decisive post-reopen checkpoint.
